programme: MAFG partners with small-MAF/NRF2-type bZIP factors to run an antioxidant/electrophile-response module (its own targets NQO1, HMOX1, NFE2L1 are the canonical ARE genes of that circuit); IRF5 and HDAC1 couple that redox state to macrophage polarization and inflammasome output (IRF5 licensing NLRP3-driven M1 macrophages, HDAC1 acting through the S1P/HDAC1 axis on the same macrophages and on chromatin during epithelial injury/repair); CEBPA sits downstream reprogramming epithelial/myeloid cell fate (AT2 plasticity) as the tissue tries to regenerate. Together these four form a chronic-injury loop: redox stress (MAFG) feeding inflammatory macrophage reprogramming (IRF5, HDAC1) and failed epithelial renewal (CEBPA).
role_in_a: In COPD this loop is the smoke-injury cycle: oxidative stress from cigarette smoke should engage the MAFG/antioxidant module in airway epithelium, IRF5 licenses NLRP3-inflammasome-driven M1 macrophage polarization in emphysema, HDAC1 operates the same S1P-dependent macrophage-polarization axis, and CEBPA governs the AT2 cell-fate plasticity that underlies (failed) alveolar regeneration — together sustaining the chronic inflammatory, poorly-repairing epithelium seen in COPD.
role_in_b: In papillary renal cell carcinoma the same axis is expected rather than directly evidenced here: IRF5 and CEBPA both carry strong independent Open Targets association with this cancer, HDAC1-driven chromatin remodeling is documented in kidney epithelium recovering from injury (a process papillary RCC is thought to arise within, via proximal-tubule injury-repair cycling), and the pseudohypoxic, redox-stressed metabolic phenotype described for papillary RCC (notably FH-deficient tumors) would be expected to engage the MAFG antioxidant module, though no retrieved paper places MAFG in this cancer directly.
shared_axis: Both diseases arise from repeated epithelial injury in a barrier tissue (smoke-damaged airway epithelium vs. injured/regenerating renal tubule) where redox imbalance and macrophage-epithelial crosstalk drive a maladaptive repair loop rather than clean healing; the same MAFG–IRF5–HDAC1–CEBPA module would be recruited in both settings because the injury-repair biology, not the organ, is what the programme responds to.
reasoning: Three of the four carrying factors (HDAC1, IRF5, CEBPA) are independently placed in COPD by literature and in kidney papillary carcinoma by Open Targets association or, for HDAC1, by a kidney-epithelial-injury paper — so each disease separately touches the programme. But nothing in the record states a direct COPD–KIRP connection, MAFG (the factor with the highest comparison support, 124/182) has no disease-specific evidence at all, and the cross-disease injury-repair logic is my inference rather than a retrieved fact, which keeps this at moderate rather than strong.
support: PMID 41639423 — IRF5 drives NLRP3/Ly6C-associated emphysema pathogenesis in COPD; PMID 37818082 — HDAC1 acts through S1P to shape macrophage polarization and inflammation in COPD; PMID 40400923 — S1P increase promotes M1 macrophage polarization via HDAC1 in COPD; PMID 34890513 — HDAC1-associated chromatin/transcriptome changes occur in kidney epithelial cells following injury; PMID 41087371 — CEBPA is part of a molecular circuit governing AT2 cell fate plasticity in lung.
how_to_falsify: In cigarette-smoke-extract-exposed airway epithelial/macrophage co-cultures, knock down MAFG and IRF5 independently: if NQO1/HMOX1 induction (MAFG's antioxidant response) and NLRP3/M1 polarization (IRF5's output) are unaffected by each other's knockdown, the proposed coupling is wrong. Separately, profile FH-deficient papillary RCC tumors for coordinate MAFG-target (NQO1, HMOX1) and IRF5/CEBPA activity relative to normal proximal tubule — absence of coordinate enrichment would falsify the cross-disease convergence claim.
caveats: Lung–kidney tissue pairing with 182 patient-group comparisons drawn from only 2 independent cohort pairs, so replication depth is shallower than the raw comparison count suggests. Only a single-view exclusion list was supplied for this pair (HSF4, ZBTB2, ZFP90, ZHX2, NKX3-2, ZNF24, YBX1, MED23, ZBTB20, HLF, RLF, PIAS2) and no tissue-generic exclusion list was given, so it cannot be confirmed whether a lung- or kidney-generic master regulator was screened out ahead of ranking. MAFG, the top-recurring factor, has no Open Targets or clear literature grounding in either disease in this record — its role here rests on target-gene logic (NQO1, HMOX1, NFE2L1), not retrieved disease-specific evidence. Six other concordant factors (NR5A2, BMAL2, PEG3, PURB, SOX11, PBX4) and FOXC1/NFATC1 were left out of the programme as either off-topic (NR5A2's liver/steroid targets), undocumented in either disease, or, for FOXC1, well placed in COPD but with no corresponding evidence in kidney papillary carcinoma.
